name: Camp Kef
description_short: Full day Jewish day camp on the Kaiserman JCC campus in Wynnewood for children from 6 weeks old through grade 10, in seven age based units from infants to counselors in training. Campers from kindergarten up swim daily in the outdoor pool, alongside sports, arts and specialty programs.
special_needs_notes: Camp runs an inclusion program with staff training to support campers with a range of needs and learning styles.
swim_waterfront_notes: Outdoor pool; kindergarten and up swim daily with instruction and free swim; ages 3 to 4 have instructional swim at least twice a week in the baby pool.
refund_policy_summary: Registration fee and weekly deposit are non-refundable. Before April 1, 2027 other payments are refundable; April 1 to May 15 they carry a 50% cancellation fee; after May 15 nothing is refunded. No refunds for absences.
notes: Camp hours 8:45 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.; early care 7:30 to 8 a.m. and late care 4 to 6 p.m. Post camp travel weeks for grades K to 5 run in late August. Snacks are provided twice a day; families pack lunch or buy kosher lunch from Nana's Kitchen. Camp is piloting bus transportation for 2027 for an added fee, details not yet posted.
